name: zmath_vec3_array_transform_direction
description: zMath::Vec3ArrayTransformDirection transforms each vector in place by the current matrix 3x3 basis, ignoring translation.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zMath/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x474670 shows early returns for identity current matrix state and non-positive count, followed by an in-place 3x3 direction transform loop with no translation term.
The native smoke checks identity no-op behavior, one-vector rotation with translation ignored, zero-count no-op behavior, and negative-count no-op behavior.
